linkedin.about: Barbara Corcoran’s credits include straight D’s in high school and college and 20 jobs by the time she turned 23. It was her next job that would make her one of the most successful entrepreneurs in the country: She borrowed $1,000 and quit her job as a waitress to start a tiny real estate company in New York City. Over the next 25 years Barbara would parlay that $1,000 loan into a $5 billion real estate business, building the largest and best-known brand in the business. Corcoran is the author of the best seller “Shark Tales: How I Turned $1,000 into a Billion Dollar Business!” and host of top business podcast “Business Unusual with Barbara Corcoran” and lifestyle podcast “888-Barbara.” Corcoran is a motivational and inspirational speaker. She is a frequent small business and real estate contributor on every major network. Corcoran has been an investor/Shark for the past ten seasons on ABC's four-time Emmy award wining show, Shark Tank, investing in over 80 businesses to date. Follow Barbara on Twitter and Instagram @BarbaraCorcoran.

posts.caption: Say goodbye to undie lines with @skimpiesbrand, the original leggings liner! 👋 Will they line up a deal with the Sharks? Find out TONIGHT on the 2-hour season premiere of #SharkTank!

Season 18 of @sharktankabc premieres tonight! After all these years (and maybe a couple of facelifts! 😉), watching someone walk into the Tank with a dream still gets me. I know what it feels like to need just one person to believe in you, and getting to be someone’s fairy godmother is the best part of this job. Here’s to more big dreams, life-changing deals, and entrepreneurs who refuse to give up. Who’s watching the two-hour premiere with me tonight? 💙🦈
We're excited to welcome @rashaun_williams to the Tank full-time! 🎉 Catch him on the 2-hour #SharkTank premiere, Wednesday at 9/8c on ABC and stream on Hulu.
Happy birthday to the KINDest Shark in the Tank! Daniel, the best thing you bring to the Tank is your big heart. Love ya! ❤️🦈
I sold my business for $66 million. He went out of business about three years later.

When I turned 35, I made my first real profit at The Corcoran Group. There was more than $40,000 left in the account at the end of the year, and I could hardly believe it. Until then, I’d put every penny we made right back into the business.

That afternoon, I was riding down the West Side Highway when I spotted a car dealership and told the taxi driver to pull over. I walked into the showroom and pointed to the smallest car, figuring it would be the cheapest.

“What’s that cute brown car in the corner?”

“A 911 Carrera.”

“That’s the brand?”

“No, ma’am. It’s a Porsche.”

“How much?”

“About $40,000.”

“I’ll take it!”

The salesman looked stunned. He told me I’d have to pay before I could drive it out, so I came back that afternoon and drove home in my brand-new Porsche. 

I figured I’d find somewhere to park it later.

I spent the next month grinding the gears before I noticed people looking at me as I drove by. That’s when I decided I needed an outfit to match. 

Here I am in my first real leather jacket and my first real cashmere headband. I figured my usual pants would do.

It’s time to ignite a spark for a new season of entrepreneurs stepping into the Tank! 🦈⚡️ 
Don’t miss the 2-hour #SharkTank premiere, Wednesday, September 30 on ABC and stream on Hulu.
